screen: Production Car creation flow, placement step (desktop 1440, full page), stage 4 pass 2

expected_differences: Demo Coffee Co., its D initial and notification counts replace the Lab’s fictional business identity and states.
Create is correctly selected instead of Content. The placement choices and step navigation belong to this production workflow; the Lab did not depict this screen.
A placement diagram replaces photographic content appropriately. It highlights the selected rear windscreen and driver door without drawing advertising onto a real vehicle.
The production configuration shows two selected placements, $250.00 per car per month and $750.00 monthly for three cars.
keep: The mineral #F4F3EF canvas, graphite #101820 rail, restrained dividers and shadow-free working regions match the approved language.
The 200px rail and 32px main gutter preserve the desktop shell. The source ends at x680 and the decision column starts at x704, retaining the 24px joint.
Keep the landscape diagram and its attached, 24px-inset financial caption. The per-car amount leads, with the monthly basis and fleet total subordinate.
Keep the visible checkboxes, selected thumbnail edges and explicit selection count. Both selected rows agree with the large diagram.
Keep the Archivo heading and money hierarchy, IBM Plex Sans operational text, ink navigation and cobalt Continue action.
Keep placement selection isolated to this step rather than adding funding, artwork or installation controls prematurely.
review.readiness_note: Sign off this desktop placement state. The capture exposes six placement choices, two consistent selections, the current step, Continue, back navigation and the business shell without clipping. Selection behavior, persistence and later publishing, fee and installation-payment behavior still require interaction testing.
review.why: This is a faithful workflow-specific transfer, not a literal copy of the Lab’s Content screen. The source-to-decision split, attached money hierarchy, typography, neutral surfaces and navigation treatment remain recognizable. The rear-window selection is drawn on the rear windscreen, and the driver-door selection matches its checkbox and thumbnail. Financial copy is explicit and internally consistent: $250.00 × 3 cars = $750.00 per month. Nothing visible implies escrow, reserved credit, an added platform fee or payment on Continue. All six options and the primary action fit within the captured page.
review.verdict: Frame Shift has been faithfully transferred to this desktop placement step, with no visible functional regression or release-blocking drift.
